reason: A media-focused DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds local vision processing, image inspection tools, and paste routing for text-only model sessions.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 Ollama 视觉模型为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图片描述、OCR、元素检测和区域查询等图像理解能力。
summaries.en: Adds local Ollama-powered image understanding to DeepSeek Harness, including image description, OCR, element detection, comparison, and region queries.

capabilities: Processes pasted or provided image files
Uses a local Ollama vision model for image description, OCR, detection, comparison, and region queries
Stores image data in local temporary or content-addressed files
Registers image inspection tools and a DeepSeek-compatible vision route
Sends generated text descriptions to the configured DeepSeek API
